claim_status: Exact finite graph/algebra certificates for listed patterns; LM residuals are retained only as historical triage data.

known_containment_coverage.interpretation: Exact on these fixed containment hits, but the deliberately stratified sample is not an unweighted population estimate.

monotonicity_certificate.consequence: a rejected pattern has no realizable alpha-at-most-two edge supergraph and is valid for non-induced containment
monotonicity_certificate.covers: eligible target covers remain eligible pattern covers; pattern L edges persist
monotonicity_certificate.defect_masks: edge additions only shrink every D_x
monotonicity_certificate.positive_definite_submatrices: target and pattern K/F graphs agree on N while the target rank upper bound can only decrease; clique and degree violations therefore persist
monotonicity_certificate.rank: on target N, upgraded pattern nonedges cannot remain in N; hence K/F patterns agree while nu_N and nu_T only decrease
monotonicity_certificate.support: shrinking support domains cannot repair infeasibility

n14_scope.candidate_nonedge_semantics: optional unit pairs; exactness follows by monotonicity over all alpha-at-most-two edge supergraphs
n14_scope.covers_enumerated: every eligible cover with size at most 7
